fusions.name: Plunging Broadhead
fusions.desc: Lofts a broad-headed arrow that falls on the first enemy it meets for 28 damage, and deals 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Felling Shot
fusions.desc: Looses a broadhead at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Whetted Heads
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Timber Call
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
